title: BuyerProfile
description: What a user stipulates when they plug into the MCP. Drives budget, criteria weights, location anchor and buy-timing. WA (Perth) scope for now.

region.description: Geographic scope. Only WA (Perth) is supported for now.

anchor.description: The suburb the user wants to live near (must exist in data/suburbs.json). Distance to every suburb is computed from here.

cash_buffer.description: Extra liquid cash beyond the deposit (AUD).

credit_line.description: Available line of credit / family facility (AUD).

credit_rate_pct.description: Interest rate on that facility (e.g. 0 for an interest-free family loan).

currently_renting.description: True if paying rent now (rent is a holding cost that makes waiting expensive).

monthly_commitments.description: Existing monthly debt repayments (AUD), reduces borrowing power.

life_stage.description: Optional shortcut: picks sensible default criteria weights, which the user can still override.

criteria.description: Importance 0-5 for each dimension. Omitted dimensions fall back to the life_stage preset. Normalised internally.

project.description: Appetite for a knock-down-rebuild or renovation.

max_distance_km.description: Hard cap on distance from the anchor.

horizon_years.description: How long until they want to be in the home.
